question.en: Light year is the unit of:
question.np: प्रकाश वर्ष (Light year) के को एकाइ हो?

explanation.en: A light year is the distance traveled by light in a vacuum in one Julian year. It is a unit of astronomical distance, equivalent to about 9.46 trillion kilometers.
explanation.np: प्रकाश वर्ष भनेको प्रकाशले एक वर्षमा पार गर्ने दूरी हो। यो खगोलीय दूरी (Distance) मापन गर्ने एकाइ हो।

question.en: The magnitude of a vector can never be:
question.np: कुनै पनि सदिशको परिमाण (Magnitude) कहिल्यै पनि के हुन सक्दैन?

explanation.en: The magnitude of a vector represents its length or quantity, which is calculated as a square root of sum of squares of components. Thus, magnitude is always a non-negative scalar (positive or zero), and can never be negative.
explanation.np: सदिशको परिमाण यसको लम्बाई वा मात्रा हो जुन सधैं धनात्मक (Positive) वा शून्य हुन्छ। यो कहिल्यै पनि ऋणात्मक (Negative) हुन सक्दैन।

question.en: When a body is thrown vertically upwards, at its highest point:
question.np: जब एउटा वस्तुलाई सिधै माथि फ्याँकिन्छ, यसको सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो विन्दुमा पुग्दा के हुन्छ?

options.en: Its velocity is zero and acceleration is g
options.np: यसको वेग शून्य र प्रवेग गुरुत्वप्रवेग (g) हुन्छ

options.en: Its velocity is zero and acceleration is zero
options.np: यसको वेग शून्य र प्रवेग शून्य हुन्छ

options.en: Its velocity is maximum and acceleration is g
options.np: यसको वेग अधिकतम र प्रवेग g हुन्छ

options.en: Its velocity is g and acceleration is zero
options.np: यसको वेग g र प्रवेग शून्य हुन्छ

explanation.en: At the highest point, the body momentarily comes to rest, so its instantaneous velocity is zero. However, it is still under the influence of gravity, so its acceleration is still equal to the acceleration due to gravity (g) pointing downwards.
explanation.np: सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो विन्दुमा पुग्दा वस्तु क्षणभरका लागि रोकिने हुनाले यसको वेग शून्य हुन्छ। तर त्यसमा लाग्ने गुरुत्व बल निरन्तर हुने हुनाले यसको प्रवेग गुरुत्वप्रवेग (g) नै रहन्छ।

question.en: A person sitting on a rotating chair stretches their arms out. Their angular velocity will:
question.np: घुमिरहेको कुर्सीमा बसेको मानिसले आफ्नो दुवै हात फैलाउँदा (Stretch) उसको कोणीय वेग (Angular velocity) के हुन्छ?

explanation.en: By stretching arms, mass is distributed further away from the rotational axis, which increases the moment of inertia (I). Since total angular momentum (L = Iω) must remain conserved, the angular velocity (ω) must decrease.
explanation.np: हात फैलाउँदा जडता आघूर्ण (I) बढ्छ। कोणीय संवेग (L = Iω) संरक्षण नियम अनुसार संवेग स्थिर राख्न कोणीय वेग (ω) घट्नु पर्छ।

question.en: The total energy of a particle executing simple harmonic motion is proportional to:
question.np: सरल आवर्त गतिमा रहेको कणको कूल ऊर्जा के सँग समानुपातिक हुन्छ?

explanation.en: The total energy E of a particle in SHM is given by E = 0.5 m ω² A², where A is the amplitude. Therefore, total energy is directly proportional to the square of the amplitude (A²).
explanation.np: सरल आवर्त गतिमा कूल ऊर्जा E = ०.५ m ω² A² हुन्छ, जहाँ A आयाम हो। तसर्थ, कूल ऊर्जा आयामको वर्ग (A²) सँग सिधा समानुपातिक हुन्छ।

question.en: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental quantity?
question.np: तलका मध्ये कुन चाहिँ आधारभूत परिमाण (Fundamental quantity) होइन?

explanation.en: In the SI system, there are 7 fundamental quantities: Mass, Length, Time, Temperature, Electric Current, Luminous Intensity, and Amount of Substance. Velocity is a derived quantity (Length / Time).
explanation.np: एसआई प्रणालीमा ७ वटा आधारभूत परिमाणहरू छन्। वेग (Velocity) लम्बाइ र समयबाट निकालिने भएकोले यो एक व्युत्पन्न (Derived) परिमाण हो।

question.en: A vector is not changed if:

options.en: It is rotated through an arbitrary angle
It is multiplied by a scalar factor
options.np: यसलाई कुनै अदिश सङ्ख्याले गुणन गर्दा

options.en: It is shifted parallel to itself
options.np: यसलाई आफैंसँग समानान्तर हुने गरी सार्दा

explanation.en: Shifting a vector parallel to itself preserves both its magnitude (length) and direction. Therefore, the vector remains unchanged.
explanation.np: सदिशलाई आफैंसँग समानान्तर हुने गरी स्थानान्तरण गर्दा यसको परिमाण र दिशा दुवै परिवर्तन हुँदैन। तसर्थ, सदिश उही रहन्छ।

question.en: For a body starting from rest and moving with uniform acceleration, the displacement is proportional to:
question.np: स्थिर अवस्थाबाट सुरु भई एकसमान प्रवेगमा गुडिरहेको वस्तुको विस्थापन के सँग समानुपातिक हुन्छ?

explanation.en: From equation of motion: s = ut + 0.5at². Since it starts from rest, u = 0, so s = 0.5at². Since acceleration a is uniform, s is directly proportional to the square of time (t²).
explanation.np: समीकरण s = ut + ०.५at² बाट। स्थिर अवस्था भएकोले u = ० ⇒ s = ०.५at²। प्रवेग स्थिर भएकोले विस्थापन समयको वर्ग (t²) सँग समानुपातिक हुन्छ।

question.en: The dimensional formula of torque is same as that of:
question.np: बल आघूर्ण (Torque) को आयामीय सूत्र केसँग मिल्दोजुल्दो हुन्छ?

explanation.en: Torque is defined as force multiplied by perpendicular distance, so its dimension is [M L T⁻²] * [L] = [M L² T⁻²]. This is exactly the same as the dimensional formula for Work and Energy.
explanation.np: बल आघूर्ण = बल * दूरी भएकोले यसको आयाम [M L² T⁻²] हुन्छ। यो कार्य वा ऊर्जाको आयामसँग मिल्छ।

question.en: The time period of a simple pendulum on a satellite orbiting the Earth is:
question.np: पृथ्वीको वरिपरि घुमिरहेको कृत्रिम उपग्रह भित्र रहेको सरल पेन्डुलमको आवर्तकाल कति हुन्छ?

explanation.en: Inside an orbiting satellite, there is a state of weightlessness where the effective acceleration due to gravity is g' = 0. Therefore, the time period T = 2π√(l/g') = 2π√(l/0) = ∞ (infinite).
explanation.np: उपग्रह भित्र भारविहिनता (Weightlessness) को अवस्था हुने हुनाले प्रभावकारी गुरुत्वप्रवेग g' = ० हुन्छ। आवर्तकाल T = २π√(l/g') = अनन्त हुन्छ।
